# Alter Behavioral Health

> > Alter Behavioral Health provides comprehensive residential mental health and addiction treatment across California, offering evidence-based therapeutic modalities for anxiety, depression, PTSD, and dual diagnosis conditions.

Founded by Michael Castanon, Alter Behavioral Health operates residential treatment centers in Southern California including Laguna Beach, Chula Vista, San Juan Capistrano, and Kearny Mesa. The organization offers a full continuum of care from Crisis Stabilization Units (CSU) through Residential Treatment (RTC), Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP), and Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP).

## Key Topics

- Residential Mental Health Treatment (RTC)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Crisis Stabilization & Intervention (CSU)
- Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
- Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
- Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
- Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
- Narrative Therapy
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dual Diagnosis Treatment
- Trauma-Informed Care
- Addiction Treatment
- Depression Treatment
- Anxiety Treatment
